title: Infrared Equivalence of Stack Presentations
exact_target: Show that different physically realizable quotient presentations of one stack lead to equivalent long-distance string theories.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30000363 (OWR-1114-004). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mini-Workshop: Heterotic Strings, Derived Categories, and Stacks (2005), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2005/53, pp. 3019--3060; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF page 19, printed page 3037.
stack GLSM analysis; reference in the saved dated catalogue literature review.

status_qualification: The source restricts to physically realizable presentations and formulates infrared equivalence as a conjecture. It neither supplies a fully defined universal RG flow nor asserts equivalence for arbitrary stack presentations; the qualification is essential.
